clue.text: Supporter audibly reduced volume? That's purely imaginary

indicators.note: audibly says the word for a supporter is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: a supporter of a team is a fan

indicators.note: reduced says the word for a volume is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a volume is a tome, a big book

explanation.surface: A fan, it seems, turned the sound down, and the whole thing was imagined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'audibly' makes FAN into the same-sounding PHAN; 'reduced' trims TOME to TOM.
explanation.definitionFit: Something phantom is an illusion with no real existence, a ghostly fancy of the mind.

clue.text: Stone depicted in exercise books by the French

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
B is short for book, so BB is books
le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: A stone drawn in the exercise books of French schoolchildren.
explanation.definitionFit: A pebble is a small smooth stone, as on a beach.

clue.text: West Indian island against curtailment of gun amnesty initially

parts.note: anti means against

indicators.note: curtailment means cutting off the tail, the last letter of gun
initially picks the first letter of amnesty

explanation.surface: A Caribbean island opposes a gun amnesty being cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: Antigua is a Caribbean island, part of the nation of Antigua and Barbuda.

clue.text: Much-loved dance? Certain to be included

indicators.note: to be included says the word for certain goes inside the word for dance

parts.note: to tread a measure is to dance, so tread is a dance step
certain means sure

explanation.surface: A favourite dance, and a sure thing to be on the programme.
explanation.walkthrough: TREAD as a dance is old-fashioned ('tread a measure').
explanation.definitionFit: Something treasured is held dear and cherished.

clue.text: Alliances with me involved various things

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled up into a new order

explanation.surface: Alliances that involved me covered all sorts.
explanation.definitionFit: Miscellanea is a collection of assorted items, a mixed bag.

clue.text: More than just a blanket description of certain plants?

definitions.text: More than just a blanket description of certain plants?

parts.words: More than just a blanket description of certain plants?
parts.note: a word covering blankets and sheets also names flowers planted out for a season

explanation.surface: A word for blankets that also covers some garden plants.
explanation.walkthrough: The word means sheets and blankets, and bedding plants are annuals set out in flowerbeds.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedding is both bedclothes and the term for plants set out in beds for display.

clue.text: Cut in annoying child support

indicators.note: cut says the word for an annoying child loses its last letter

parts.note: an annoying child is a brat

explanation.surface: Cutting back the support an annoying child receives.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra is a supporting undergarment.

clue.text: Leading editor held up in warehouse

indicators.note: in a down clue, held up says the whole run is read from bottom to top

parts.note: leading means top, first

explanation.surface: The chief editor has been delayed at the warehouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held up' reverses TOPED to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is a storehouse or warehouse for goods.

clue.text: Rerun is broadcast-one delivers a definite return in difficult times

definitions.text: one delivers a definite return in difficult times

indicators.note: broadcast, scattering widely, says the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A rerun is on air, and an underwriter pays out when things go wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: An underwriter of policies pays out when a claim follows misfortune.

clue.text: Item in orbit not admitting of observation?

definitions.text: Item in orbit not admitting of observation?

parts.words: Item in orbit not admitting of observation?
parts.note: orbit is the eye socket; an artificial object there that cannot see

explanation.surface: Something circling in space that cannot be observed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orbit' suggests space; it is the bony socket of the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A prosthetic eyeball made of glass sits in the socket but gives no sight.

clue.text: Severely criticise main location of pet sanctuary

parts.note: to batter is to attack or criticise severely
the main is a literary word for the sea

explanation.surface: Laying into the main site of an animal shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: BATTERSEA is a district of south London, home of the famous Dogs and Cats Home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Battersea Dogs and Cats Home in London is a famous refuge for strays.

clue.text: Dish finished by start of afternoon

parts.note: something finished is past

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of afternoon

explanation.surface: A meal eaten by early afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: Spaghetti, penne and the like make up an Italian dish.

clue.text: African city is backward? Nothing in that

indicators.note: in says the letter for nothing goes inside the word for falling behind

parts.note: something that is backward lags behind
O, the figure zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: A remark that an African city is behind the times, with nothing in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Lagos is the largest city in Nigeria.

clue.text: How to pay for non-intensive private education?

explanation.surface: A question about paying for relaxed private schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: Easy terms are instalments; read literally, they are undemanding school terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying in easy instalments is buying on credit; light school sessions would be an untaxing course of study.

clue.text: One improves things by delivering grain

definitions.text: One improves things by delivering grain

parts.words: One improves things by delivering grain
parts.note: a cleaning machine fires fine grit at a surface to smooth it

explanation.surface: A farmer improving things with a delivery of grain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grain' suggests cereal; it is particles of grit.
explanation.definitionFit: This machine cleans stone or metal by blasting it with grit under pressure.

clue.text: Comedy team with uncommon allure and likely to last?

indicators.note: uncommon, unusual, says the letters are rearranged

parts.note: with means and, joining things
hardy means robust, likely to survive

explanation.surface: A comedy double act with rare charm and staying power.
explanation.definitionFit: Stan and Ollie were a classic double act of early Hollywood slapstick.

clue.text: Car: footballer's first to get out?

indicators.note: first says the get-out word goes before the footballer in the answer

parts.note: a chick hatches when it gets out of its egg
a back is a defending football player

explanation.surface: A car belonging to a footballer who is first to leave.
explanation.definitionFit: A car with a rear door hinged at the top, opening up the boot.

clue.text: Old band is primarily into playing rock

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are played around with
primarily picks the first letter of into

explanation.surface: An old band is chiefly into playing rock music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' rearranges BAND, IS and I (from 'primarily into') into BSIDIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark volcanic glass formed when lava cools fast.

clue.text: Everyday formation of soldiers?

explanation.surface: Routine military drill for the troops.
explanation.walkthrough: Soldiers are strips of buttered toast for dipping into a boiled egg, a British breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: Basic routine work is one's staple; buttered strips of bread are what toast soldiers consist of.

clue.text: Deleting time that's wrong? Good

parts.note: an era is a period of time
a sin is something wrong

explanation.surface: Removing a moment that was a mistake is a good thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbing out marks or text is removing them.

clue.text: European politician's drawn and exhausted

parts.note: MP, member of parliament, is a politician
a drawn match is tied

explanation.surface: A Euro MP is weary and worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: A container used up or drained to nothing is cleaned out.

clue.text: Vulgar Frenchman second to be involved in swindle

indicators.note: to be involved in says the Frenchman and the second go inside the swindle

parts.note: a con is a swindle
M, for monsieur, is a Frenchman
a mo is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: A coarse Frenchman soon finds himself mixed up in a fraud.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse, low-class behaviour is ill-bred and crude.

clue.text: Some cheat-a Roman — is back as a lover

indicators.note: back says those letters run from right to left
some means only part of the words is used

explanation.surface: A Roman cheat returns as a lover.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'cheat-a Roman is' backwards and the answer lies in it.
explanation.definitionFit: An inamorata is a woman someone is in love with, a sweetheart.

clue.text: Chamber group in concert etc obviously upset

indicators.note: upset says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A chamber ensemble is clearly upset at a concert.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' turns the letters TETCO (inside 'concert etc obviously') upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight musicians playing together form a chamber ensemble.

clue.text: Animal's joint operation meeting with setback

parts.note: the hip is a joint

indicators.note: with setback says the operation word is turned back to front

explanation.surface: A hip operation for an animal that hits a snag.
explanation.definitionFit: A large African river mammal, short for hippopotamus.

clue.text: Identification returned to one dozy person

indicators.note: returned says the run of to and one is written backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An ID card handed back to a sleepy person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns TO plus I into IOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool, someone slow on the uptake.

clue.text: Miscast or otherwise being excluded?

indicators.note: otherwise, in another way, says the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actor miscast or else left out.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shut out by a group, shunned or cold-shouldered.

clue.text: Individual taking drug?

parts.note: someone on a medication is taking it
E is ecstasy, a drug

explanation.surface: A person taking drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A single person or thing, a unit.

clue.text: Close and fasten lingerie item

parts.note: nigh means near, close
to tie is to fasten

explanation.surface: Closing and fastening an item of underwear.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose nightdress worn in bed.

clue.text: Reprobate's racket accumulated money?

parts.note: a rake is a dissolute man, a reprobate
a din is a racket, a loud noise

explanation.surface: A scoundrel's racket brought in loads of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Earning plenty, gathering cash in large amounts.
